description: This file defines the 'perf_informix' class for performance monitoring and tuning in an Informix database context, including SQL queries and configurations related to database performance metrics.
external_methods: select value from sysmaster:sysprofile where name='pagreads'
select value from sysmaster:sysprofile where name='pagwrites'
select round((1-(wt.value / (rd.value + wr.value)))*100,2) from sysmaster:sysprofile wr, sysmaster:sysprofile rd, sysmaster:sysprofile wt

classes.name: perf_informix
classes.description: A class for monitoring and tuning database performance metrics specifically for Informix, extended from adodb_perf.

methods.description: Constructor for the perf_informix class, initializes with a database connection.
